title: Mere Asghar Aa Gayi
body:
chod ke turbat ghar may aaja
godh may kar aaraam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
bano dukhiya karti hai nauha
qaime may hai korhaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban phaili hui hai
masnad e zainab khaak bani hai
tujhko dhoonde teri sakina
pani ka le kar jaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mat bhulo ulfat ke kareene
ghutniyo chalte aao madine
khat may likh kar bheja hai tumko
sughra ne paighaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal gaye qaime lut gaya jhoola
aah karoo to padta hai durra
subha se shab tak shab se saher tak
rona hai mera kaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ko aa kar ruqsat kar do
aankhon ke saagar ashkon se bhar do
qaidi ban kar karbobala se
jaate hai hum shaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mahir hai bano ke naale
godh may meri kyun nahi aate
raat ke sannate may tumko
kaise mila aaram asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
author: Mahir Lakhnavi
